---
name: Adapter behaviour
about: Yenop answered wrongly, or a runtime did something the adapter did not expect
title: "[runtime] short description"
labels: adapter
---

Runtime behaviour is version-specific. Please fill in every version; the report is not actionable without them.

**Yenop version** (`yenop version`):
**Runtime and version** (e.g. Cursor 3.21.18, Gemini CLI 0.60.0, Codex CLI 0.155.1, Claude Code 2.1.282, `@openai/agents` 0.18.0):
**Operating system**:

**What the agent tried** (the prompt, or the exact tool call):

**What Yenop answered** (`yenop receipts --last 5`; the line carries the rule id):

**What you expected**:

**Observed vs documented**: if the runtime behaved differently from its documentation, say what the docs claim and what you saw.

If this is a bypass (an action Yenop should have denied or held, and did not), please email security@yenop.com instead of opening a public issue; see SECURITY.md.
